source_tests.method: Complete no-fail-fast denominator plus exact corrected targets; no false exit0 for failed full invocation.

qualifications.bounded_reviews_not_whole_fact_acceptanc: This is a proposed evidence binding. Each review remains bounded to its stated implementation/receipt scope; root alone disposes the complete fact or vision. Neither task overlap, a requirement's wording nor a documents edge proves behavior.
qualifications.retained_behavioral_receipts: Retain the existing ledger's named behavior/acceptance evidence at its stated scope; unchanged applicable receipts need no ceremonial rerun. This candidate does not expand an aggregate panel into invented per-variant tests.
qualifications.produced_root_comparison_limit: Existing-root multi-kind and NoOp comparison is supported. Comparison evaluates the union of roots on the base snapshot and may refuse a root created only by an earlier simulated effect. Arbitrary produced-root comparison remains unclaimed for both ALTERNATIVES-AND-NO-OP and SCOPED-CAUSAL-BASIS.
qualifications.dreamer_existing_obligations_only: Accepted Dreamer additions use existing active-outcome obligations; creating outcomes/obligations is the ordinary path. Detached exploration creates no live authority, holds or completion debt merely by existing.
qualifications.simulated_host_distinction: Deterministic host/weak-transcript protocol evidence is labeled simulation. Real captured artifacts/registered service transitions are not evidence that a native model actually executed or that a weak model has stronger/independent judgment.
qualifications.archive_fixture_scope: R09's accepted protocol fixture has one packet per bundle. R15A separately proves overlapping two-packet physical capture and production archive bytes; these distinct fixtures are not represented as one combined live-model test.
qualifications.packet_policy_not_model_quality: Root binds the exact routing/packing and unsafe-abstraction/full-boot deterministic tests. They prove their stated policy/invariant boundaries, not the quality of a weak model or every hypothetical abstraction.
qualifications.native_capability_limit: The selected real native probe made two thread-limit-refused spawn calls with no handle/start/effect. Successful live inference, actual model/effort telemetry and real slot release remain unobserved. The Owner amendment removes a mandatory repeat native-LLM gate; no fallback or success is invented.
qualifications.profiles_are_policy: Default role/provider/model/effort values are Owner-configurable workflow policy. Desired and actually resolved profiles remain separate from trusted authority and observed capability.
qualifications.native_goal_unobserved: Deterministic projection, cached operation support and recorded unsupported/manual behavior do not claim a native goal was changed. Successful native goal acknowledgment remains unobserved and is not a mandatory repeated release experiment.
qualifications.runtime_budget_scope: Accepted R17 runtime sequence 8 includes the final snapshot/occupancy/packet-availability/Unknown-boundary repairs. Its budget counts runtime index/read work and read-port calls; nested basis/admission costs retain separate bounds. Generated 4,101-record fixtures are not universal latency/memory measurements.
qualifications.deterministic_nonempty_completion: The accepted nonempty R16 two-job campaign uses actual Rust packet/material/runtime/provenance/evidence/stage/work/closure routes with an explicitly deterministic producer and independent oracle. It supersedes the old empty-outcome-only gap and does not claim a live native launch.
qualifications.trusted_local_boundary: Opaque seals, one-writer/store-guard ownership and canonical recovery/audit support the documented trusted-local boundary. A lease, self-hash or worker promise is not OS confinement; hostile-administrator resistance is not claimed.
qualifications.admission_locality_scope: The shipped WorkRenamed whole-transaction decorator proves no raw scans for that path. Basis, affected-scope, pause/exception, live-hold and runtime budgets have distinct scopes; global completion/project sources remain legitimately global.
qualifications.exact_record_view_scope: Accepted NoOp projected-record lookup exposes a present registered record's full canonical serialized value under a valid basis and one snapshot. Empty-root Mutation refuses; Completion may be global/budgeted. Keys are 1–4096 bytes. Absent unknown-family rows can return None before registry lookup. No backend value-byte cap, key-discovery catalog or individual test for every family is claimed; HTTP bounds remain separate.
qualifications.navigation_measurement_scope: Viewer lookup/search/adjacency and durable traversal are bounded backend interfaces. Earlier 10k timings retain their exact source identity; later algorithms and runtime continuation do not inherit fresh latency claims.
qualifications.process_environment_scope: Pure-core/domain/runtime effect separation was source-inspected; the installed ambient-env checker only checks env-variable access. Material-relative paths use the configuration directory; other relative paths and the configured Vibe child's inherited environment/cwd remain documented. No hermetic subprocess or general effects analyzer is claimed.
qualifications.historical_epoch_scope: Legacy zap/1 codec/digest identities and physical store v1/v2 remain separate from StoreEpoch and package version. Source-reviewed schema-1 index-scope adaptation is not relabeled as a newly executed historical replay scenario.
qualifications.nonzero_import_limit: Frozen zap/1 readers/archives preserve their supported history, while normalized application import requires revision zero and refuses unsupported nonzero normalization. Explicit tiny-contract activation is separate from inactive import and never authorizes actual NEXT execution.
qualifications.historical_prototype_scope: Historical prototype schemas, scripts, import measurements and dated design records remain evidence/provenance rather than current installed runtime capability or operational prerequisites.
qualifications.artifact_superseded: Prior R15B clean-consumer evidence proves the assembly/offline-install/registry-unavailable-build mechanism only. The earlier 374-file mechanism artifact and later 524-file artifact are superseded for final publication. Final dependency/source/payload/slot/binary identities and installed journeys must bind current bytes.
qualifications.performance_measurement_scope: A1/A2 allocation, record/history size, NTFS allocation and warm-read values apply to their exact recorded fixtures/configurations. Fresh process is not cold disk; combined commit+verify is not isolated commit; no old/reference whole-path baseline or universal whole-operation gain is inferred.
qualifications.focused_verification_scope: AMENDMENT-FINAL-VALIDATION selects applicable retained algorithm receipts plus meaningful deterministic changed-boundary checks. It does not waive implementation, coherent production gates, installation or publication, and does not require speculative per-variant or repeated live/large tests.
qualifications.documentary_not_behavioral: Reviewed macro/type catalogs and source-preserving documents edges supply public-use/traceability support. Doctest and documentary counts remain distinct; the all-fact mechanical index does not accept every semantic requirement or execute every type.
qualifications.future_client_scope: The Rust product supplies framework-independent machine data/read/admission/navigation foundations. The interactive canvas, game-like art and future IDE presentation remain separate client work; those UI behaviors are not claimed implemented and are not silently converted into backend tests.
qualifications.prohibitions_remain: NEXT execution and installed local Qwen inference remain prohibited. Import, installation and simulated/deterministic fixtures grant no activation or execution authority.
